query:
SELECT i.id AS "id!"
             FROM identity_directory_groups idg
             JOIN directory_groups dg ON dg.id = idg.directory_group_id
             JOIN identities i ON i.id = idg.identity_id
            WHERE idg.directory_group_id = $1
              AND dg.org_id = $2
              AND i.org_id = $2
            ORDER BY i.name
